summary.intent: Execute GSD Phase 19.1 to extract a core crypto SDK as a shared package, splitting @cipherbox/crypto into @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/crypto, creating @cipherbox/api-client, @cipherbox/sdk-core, and @cipherbox/sdk packages, then rewiring the web app hooks to use the new SDK.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans executed and verified. 4 new packages created and published. Web app rewired to use SDK for folder CRUD, file upload, download, and bin operations. 9/9 Playwright UAT tests passing. PR #296 opened with CI fixes and review comments resolved.

repo: setApiClientConfig() from @cipherbox/api-client must be called during SDK initialization in useAuth.ts before any IPNS operations — without it all SDK folder/file mutations silently fail with 'API client not configured'
FolderEntry.id is a UUID used for navigation lookups, while ipnsName (k51...) is used for IPNS operations — conflating them breaks folder navigation after create

The web app has a dual-path IPNS write problem: old services and SDK both increment IPNS sequence numbers independently causing 409 Conflicts — the fix is to route all operations through one path (SDK)
SDK bin state requires loadBin() to be called AFTER initializeBin() (old service), not before — the old service creates the bin IPNS record which SDK then reads
ensureFolderRegistered must skip if SDK already has the folder — overwriting SDK's internal state (seq number, keys) with stale Zustand store data causes 409 Conflicts on subsequent mutations
The _sdkUnsubscribe cleanup function should be stored at module-level, not in Zustand state — storing it in state triggers spurious re-renders on every subscribe call
btoa(String.fromCharCode(...spread)) on Uint8Array throws stack overflow for large payloads — use loop-based base64 encoding instead (already fixed in file module but missed in ipns module)
Axios instance must be cached after setApiClientConfig() — creating a new axios.create() per API call prevents connection reuse
CI typecheck runs tsc -b before packages are built — the root typecheck script must build all dependent packages first
CI api:generate runs the full pipeline (start API, regenerate openapi.json, regenerate clients) — local partial regeneration (orval only) produces different output

code.finding: SDK bin loading must happen after initializeBin() completes, not before — old service creates the bin IPNS record, then SDK reads it
ensureFolderRegistered skips if SDK already has the folder (client.hasFolder check) — overwriting is harmful because SDK's seq number and keys are authoritative after first registration
loadBin returns empty BinState (not null) when no IPNS record exists — this allows deleteToBin to work on fresh accounts without throwing 'Bin not loaded'
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish retries once on 409 by re-resolving IPNS sequence number — handles stale seq from concurrent sessions or background polling
destroy() zeros vault key material (privateKey, publicKey, rootFolderKey) — addresses M-2 from security review
uploadedCids array tracks CIDs for cleanup on failure but was never used in catch block — re-added unpin calls for orphan cleanup
createFolder returns id (UUID from FolderEntry), ipnsName, folderKey, and ipnsPrivateKey — callers need the UUID for store lookup, not the ipnsName
axiosInstance is now cached module-level after setApiClientConfig — previously created a new axios.create() on every API call

workflow: When debugging SDK/web integration issues, first validate at the SDK level with a direct integration test (vitest against live API) before touching the browser — isolates whether the bug is in the SDK or the web wiring
For Playwright MCP debugging sessions: get OTP by reading the backgrounded pnpm dev task output file (grep for 'DEV OTP') — not from Web3Auth static test credentials
For Playwright file upload: use browser_evaluate to click the hidden <input type='file'> element directly — the upload zone overlay intercepts pointer events on the visible button
Use fresh email addresses for each Playwright test run to avoid auth_methods constraint violations and slow vault sync from accumulated IPNS records
When making atomic commits during a session with many changes, save full file state before splitting — use git stash or temp files to restore/restore incrementally
Running integration tests requires the dev server — always start pnpm dev before running SDK integration tests, don't skip them
CI coverage thresholds should reflect unit-test-only coverage (what CI actually runs), not combined unit+integration coverage that runs locally

friction: 1Password SSH agent signing blocked commits repeatedly when running in background subprocess — required user to be physically present at keyboard to unlock
OTP rate limiting (5 sends per 15 minutes) blocked Playwright login loops — had to clear Redis rate limit keys manually
pnpm dev task output file (OTP source) gets killed between sessions, requiring restart and fresh OTP each Playwright session
CI detected API spec drift because local orval regeneration differs from CI's full pnpm api:generate pipeline — needed full API running to regenerate properly
CI test step ran crypto package tests before building @cipherbox/core, causing vault-ipns.test.ts import to fail — required adding a package build step before tests in CI
Branch was initially reset to main mid-session after user was unhappy with Plan 02 decisions — lost first run's partial work
Multiple rounds of debugging the ensureFolderRegistered bridge before realizing the real fix was eliminating the dual-path entirely by routing upload through SDK
Playwright MCP browser_file_upload doesn't work directly on hidden inputs — requires browser_evaluate workaround to trigger the file chooser
open_items: Batch SDK operations: N sequential IPNS publishes for multi-select operations (move 10 items = 20 publishes) — SDK needs moveItems/deleteItems batch methods for O(1) publish count
uint8ToBase64 has 3 copies (sdk-core/file, web/folder.service, web/file-metadata.service) — should be consolidated into @cipherbox/crypto per REFACTORING.md row 3.3
TEE key wrapping pattern duplicated 3+ times across sdk-core/folder, sdk-core/file, sdk/bin — needs shared helper
Constants IPNS_LIFETIME_MS, MAX_VERSIONS_PER_FILE, BIN_METADATA_VERSION duplicated between sdk-core and web app services — should be exported from @cipherbox/core
Dual bin loading on login (initializeBin + loadBin) does double IPNS resolution — deferred until Plan 06's old service removal
@internal methods on CipherBoxClient (getConfig, getContext, emitEvent) are public TypeScript — consider friend-pattern or restructuring bin/share as class methods
O(N) linear folder lookup on every SDK folder:loaded/folder:updated event — should use reverse lookup map ipnsName->folderId
Deprecated services (folder.service, bin.service, share.service, ipns.service) still have active callers in folder-helpers.ts resyncFolder — need full migration in a future phase
SDK unit test coverage for bin/share modules is 34% in CI (no unit tests, only integration tests which are skipped in CI) — needs dedicated unit tests
deferred-items.md in phase directory tracks additional items noted during execution that weren't in scope
